Name: Mushroom Tree Variety for Alternative Textures
Author: vacantgalaxy
Description:
This pack requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. Install those first if you don't already have them.

Credit goes to allanbachti for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1729]Mushroom Tree Re-texture[/url] and Irkensnacks for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3558]Recolored Mushroom Trees[/url]. I simply used their assets and repackaged them for ease of use with Alternative Textures. 

No known incompatibilities, does not overwrite or override default textures in any way.﻿


To install, simply unzip this pack in your mod folder.

To uninstall just delete the pack folder from your mod folder. Any recolored mushroom trees will revert back to the default texture.

Mushroom trees will pick up a random textures from the available color/style options.
To change color or style manually, use the Alternative Textures Paint Bucket available at Robin's shop.
